tasks.commitBody:
An MCP server for the rights model, as commissioned: a VIEW, never a second home. A build-time generator reads docs/architecture/entu-rights-and-visibility-model.md plus the source commit SHA and emits a gitignored rules bundle; rights_rule(id) serves one rule verbatim with its evidence and probe paths, rights_rules(topic) serves matching identifiers, and every response — including empty ones and health — carries the source commit AND its date, so a stale answer is detectable at a glance rather than merely plausible (Gama's dated-stamp ask). Minimal JSON-RPC/MCP dispatch and a thin CF Worker fetch entry, pure-node tested; no new runtime dependencies; no auth layer per mitselek's on-issue ruling.

Review round (YELLOW, findings on the issue): the transport now honors the real client handshake — notifications get 202 with no body, the optional SSE stream is declined with 405, DELETE/OPTIONS answer properly with CORS — and the full client sequence is pinned in the spec; the generated-bundle import is typed via an ambient declaration valid with the bundle present or absent; and workers/ gains its own typecheck gate (check:workers) chained into pnpm check, closing the hole the type finding shipped through.

The runbook states the refresh path in plain words — after activation, a doc edit reaches the server only when someone redeploys — and answers that a push-triggered deploy workflow is feasible but needs a Cloudflare API token secret, which is Mihkel's infra call. Deployment is deliberately NOT part of this change: wrangler.jsonc and the runbook land here, but activation at mvox.eu (and the path-vs-subdomain routing choice) waits on explicit PO authorization. #318 therefore stays open at this merge and closes when the server is live.

Part of #316.

(*MVOX:Palestrina*)
